Meta.title: Word Filter Plus
Meta.author: DK
Meta.description:
[h1]Word Filter Plus[/h1]
Extends Elin's distribution/stock word filters with new token types:
[h2]Element matching — [code]@element[/code][/h2] Matches items that have a given skill or element on them, exactly like the in-game Ctrl+F search. [code]@fire[/code] — distributes all fire-enchanted gear. Only matches identified items (unidentified items are never matched by element).
[h2]Identified predicate — [code]@identified[/code][/h2] Restricts the filter to identified or unidentified items only. [code]@identified[/code] — distributes only identified items. [code]-@identified[/code] — distributes only unidentified items.
[h2]Rarity comparison — [code]rarity:OPname[/code][/h2] Filters by rarity tier using [code]= > >= < <=[/code]. [code]rarity:>=good[/code] — distributes Superior (good) and above. Rarity names (case-insensitive): [code]crude normal superior legendary mythical artifact[/code] Display name aliases also accepted: [code]good miracle godly artefact precious[/code]
[h2]Notes[/h2] [list] [*] All token types mix freely with each other and with plain name filters. [*] Block/pass operators ([code]-[/code] and [code]+[/code]) work with all token types. [*] Zero overhead on rules that use none of the new tokens. [*] Requires the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3413072131]Package Chainloader[/url] mod (FixedPackageLoader) to load correctly when installed from Workshop. [/list]
